listing.name: The Lion's Guard 0.03e (Now Redundant)
listing.summary: This mod simply added Lion's Guard skins to Sindrian Diktat and Lion's Guard ships. It's now been folded into Ship and Weapon Pack, HERE. However, this mod is really simple, so I'm keeping it up for first-time modders to copy-paste-despair from it.
